option_codebook.name: Plot progression and turning points — Introduce the inciting incident early; escalate rising complications through trials; deliver crisis, peak tension at climax, and an apt denouement.
Earned payoff and climax — Climactic payoffs follow logically from prior setup and causality, test character arcs, and feel deserved—often resonating beyond tidy closure.

Plot Coherence, Unity, and Appropriate Magnitude — A single, whole action with clear beginning–middle–end whose parts follow by probability/necessity; the design is planned for clarity and momentum, and the magnitude/length is graspable yet weighty enough to produce significant change.

Suspense and Sustained Pressure — Build and sustain tension via specific, escalating stakes, strong antagonistic forces and plans, controlled information and foreshadowing, and unanticipated consequences; ensure payoffs are earned.

option_codebook.name: Sentence rhythm, variety, and musicality — Vary sentence structures and lengths with control; use rhythm, repetition, and lyrical moments judiciously to carry action and tone.

Sentence‑level rhythm, sound, and memorability — Vary and tune sentence length, cadence, punctuation, and diction (including dialogue exchange length) to action/emotion for clarity, music, and resonance.
